prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Pearland, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1437; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling eastbound in the left-turn lane at an intersection in Pearland, Texas, when the collision occurred. Driver 1 stated that the vehicle was struck on the driver's side by Driver 2, whose vehicle was proceeding straight through the intersection after turning from the opposite direction. Driver 1 reported a concussion and was transported for evaluation. Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat and was also present at the scene, and both the responding officer and the other parties confirmed Passenger's presence in the vehicle at the time of impact. The reported injury is consistent with the type and force of the collision as observed at the scene. Photographs taken at the scene confirm several of the reported details, and the visible damage to both vehicles is largely consistent with the described impact sequence. No independent witnesses were identified. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was known to the parties or observed by the officer. Driver 1 is listed as the named driver on the insurance policy covering the vehicle involved.
